onboarding.missingInputs: Onboarding cannot be submitted from this form. POST /sites requires a site ID, region and river; CRS; far-field and near-field bounds, resolutions and inflow locations; and dam IDs, types, locations and complete breach specifications. The form does not collect all these fields, and DEM/hydrology uploads are disabled. No site will be submitted.
